Locally hosted fonts. No third-party font requests are made while playing.

Lora (normal and italic variable fonts, 400–700)
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/lora
License: lora-OFL.txt

Be Vietnam Pro (regular, semibold, bold)
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/bevietnampro
License: be-vietnam-OFL.txt

The original TrueType files were converted to WOFF without changing glyphs.
